issues.description: Stock.take(String) has inconsistent return types across artifacts: the problem statement/UML specifies `take(String): int` (used with `-1` as failure sentinel), but the template repository declares `public boolean take(String ingredient)`. This mismatch makes it unclear how SealSaloon.checkOrderReady() should detect failure and causes student implementations following the UML to not compile against the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template API with the UML/solution by changing `Stock.take(String)` in the template to `public int take(String ingredient)` and implement it to return the new remaining quantity on success and `-1` on failure (ingredient missing or insufficient quantity).
